pages.text: Use a water-filled vanilla cauldron above a lit campfire. Add ingredients in JEI order, wait for heating, then collect with a glass bottle. Each batch uses one water level. Sneak-use with an empty hand to cancel and recover ingredients. Vegetable Base is VG; Clear Base is PG.

Fill the Liquid Blending Bench with carrier bases, optional nicotine, and up to three essences. Each chosen flavor consumes one full essence dose per 250 mB batch. Ingredient bottles return through Glass. Left-click VG/PG to increase VG; right-click to increase PG. Auto waits for the same flavors when supplies run out.

Insert a blank Liquid Recipe Card and press Save Recipe. It remembers the formula and can be renamed in an anvil to name the finished liquid. Saved cards fix flavors for repeat batches and Create lines. The trash button discards stored essences, clears the flavor recipe, and stops Auto.

Sneak-use the Vape Pen to refill or charge. A redstone dust restores 20% charge. Hold use for a longer draw; more VG produces larger, longer-lived clouds. Nicotine strength changes the Nicotine effect, while nicotine-free liquids still produce clouds.

Create uses heated Mixers and Basins for extraction. Put one saved Recipe Card in each blending Basin. Combine VG and PG first, then nicotine and one essence at a time. A flavor stage consumes a full 250 mB essence dose. Pipe the finished liquid to a Spout for bottling. Cards are reusable.
